## Final adversarial evidence

1. Zero pre-confirmation side effects remains intact. Streaming and nonterminal recognition only update the read-only review model/presenter, final action-2 waits for the recorder barrier before `.editable`, draft edits only update coordinator authority, and `reviewDestinationDelivery.deliver` remains reachable only from `handleReviewConfirmation` after an opaque UI intent, exact revision check, text safety check, and 16,384 UTF-16 cap (`FeishuSpeech/ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift:1619-1806`, `:1889-2019`). The final zero-side-effect ledger passed again and observed no delivery, copy, legacy final output, current-focus output, or AX selected-text write across capture, streaming, sealing, and edits (`FeishuSpeechTests/ReviewFirstMainViewModelTests.swift:1040-1098`).

2. The residual clipboard/Cmd+V mechanism remains structurally absent. A fresh production search found no `NSPasteboard`, general-pasteboard read/write/clear/restore, `changeCount`, `kVK_ANSI_V`, `postCommandV`, Cmd+V, or Command+V operation in `FeishuSpeech`. The remaining pasteboard-named protocols are methodless compatibility markers, not capabilities (`FeishuSpeech/Services/TextInputSimulator.swift:390-397`, `:666-674`). All seven pasteboard lifecycle tests passed in the final re-run, including image-only clipboard preservation and exact/application-bound uncertainty without retry.

3. The 16,384-unit cap, surrogate safety, and exact prepared payload remain layered. `MainViewModel` rejects 16,385 before delivery/activation (`FeishuSpeech/ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift:1950-1973`); the poster independently rejects it before source/event construction, constructs one down/up pair from the same complete UTF-16 array, and requires full readback (`FeishuSpeech/Services/TextInputSimulator.swift:775-838`). The backend checks same source wrapper, phase, exact payload, empty flags, tag, own source PID, and captured target PID (`:1097-1141`). The executable non-BMP boundary and every readback-fault test passed (`FeishuSpeechTests/FinalTextOutputSecurityTests.swift:514-599`).

4. Prepared-pair provenance is fail closed. Both events share one private-state source and full payload, receive the fixed tag and captured PID before readback, and cannot reach the submit function unless all readbacks succeed (`FeishuSpeech/Services/TextInputSimulator.swift:796-838`). Self-event exemption remains conjunctive exact tag plus `eventSourceUnixProcessID == getpid()` (`:597-606`); foreign, missing, zero-PID, and wrong-tag cases remain interference in both event-tap epoch and AppKit-monitor tests (`FeishuSpeechTests/CurrentFocusAppendSessionTests.swift:598-802`). Tap-disabled events still advance loss-of-observability before any exemption (`FeishuSpeech/Services/CurrentFocusAppendSession.swift:204-215`; `FeishuSpeech/Services/HotKeyService.swift:200-223`).

5. The first down remains the irreversible boundary and mandatory up remains unconditional afterward. Submission is `notStarted` until the down post; immediately after that call it becomes `submissionBoundaryCrossed`; after-down, before-up, after-up, cancellation, and postflight faults can only mark uncertainty and never suppress the synchronous up attempt (`FeishuSpeech/Services/TextInputSimulator.swift:841-892`). The repaired tests now execute every hook and cancellation boundary, asserting zero phases before down and exact down/up phases and captured PID after the boundary (`FeishuSpeechTests/FinalTextOutputSecurityTests.swift:601-733`).

6. Correctness R1 is closed. Binding-specific exact AX validation now runs before `insertReviewPair` (`FeishuSpeech/Services/TextInputSimulator.swift:232-263`), and application-bound trust/Secure Input/frontmost/identity validation also runs before it (`:285-309`). Therefore neither AX/application validation nor event construction blocks the physical-input epoch writer. Only after those operations does the short gate acquire activation then input ordering, compare both baselines and drift flags, sample Command/Shift/Control/Option/Fn/Caps Lock immediately before down, and invoke only the already-prepared pair (`FeishuSpeech/Services/ReviewDestinationDelivery.swift:369-409`; shared input lock at `FeishuSpeech/Services/CurrentFocusAppendSession.swift:176-215`). A modifier or physical/activation epoch drift during validation is visible at this final gate and yields zero post. The executable exact/application matrix flips Command, Shift, Control, Option, and Fn from inside final validation and now proves `.deliveryFailed`, zero posts, and only prepared/read-back events (`FeishuSpeechTests/FinalTextOutputSecurityTests.swift:735-828`).

7. Monitor provenance and postflight remain conservative. Both monitors are armed before activation and baselined only after stabilization (`FeishuSpeech/Services/ReviewDestinationDelivery.swift:290-367`); final and postflight checks cover both epochs, both drift callbacks, and all relevant combined-session flags (`:369-435`). Any crossed-boundary validation or epoch drift becomes `deliveryUncertain`, not a retry or consumed claim (`:671-684`; `FeishuSpeech/Services/TextInputSimulator.swift:341-358`).

8. Confirmation authority remains opaque and UI-bound. `ReviewConfirmationIntent` still has only a `fileprivate` initializer and is constructed only by the visible Send action or qualified native Return/Enter path (`FeishuSpeech/Views/TranscriptionReviewView.swift:14-24`, `:229-247`, `:347-370`). `MainViewModel` has no zero-argument or optional-revision confirmation API, and its in-flight fence prevents repeated UI callbacks from causing multiple attempts (`FeishuSpeech/ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift:1809-1837`, `:1950-1985`).

9. Output never claims target consumption. Review delivery uses `submittedUnverified`; even a legacy `.inserted` is conservatively translated at the review boundary, postflight drift is uncertain, and every result returns the exact frozen draft to `.editable` with typed feedback (`FeishuSpeech/Services/ReviewDestinationDelivery.swift:41-51`, `:671-684`, `:869-889`; `FeishuSpeech/ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift:2044-2120`). No automatic retry, copy, retarget, or recovery output exists.

10. Asynchronous recording/recognition topology and drain expiry are safe. Capture drain and recognition consumer remain independent tasks (`FeishuSpeech/ViewModels/MainViewModel.swift:650-672`), Fn release starts the recorder barrier while recognition drain remains separately admitted (`:2191-2269`), and normal action-2 still awaits that barrier (`:1689-1761`). On drain expiry, the code snapshots the latest preview, closes admission, invalidates late work, and may republish only a same-generation, nonempty, safe, LF-free, capped draft as `.editable`; the helper performs no delivery, AX write, Unicode/keyboard post, pasteboard, copy, retry, or retarget (`:2272-2371`). Both the provisional-preservation and unsafe/no-safe-output drain tests passed in the final re-run.
